architecture.summary: Feature areas live under src/app/features/<area>. Each area owns its routes, a facade service and a signal store. Shared presentational components live in src/app/shared/components.

list: Components use the OnPush strategy unless they hold mutable timers.
Constants are UPPER_SNAKE_CASE in a co-located constants file.
conventions.naming: Files are kebab-case with a type suffix: order-list.component.ts.

ui.precedence: The primary component library is used for every widget it covers; the secondary library is used only for dialogs and autocomplete.
ui.icons: Use the icon font declared in package.json; decorative icons get aria-hidden.

i18n.pattern: Bind visible text through the translate pipe: {{ 'orders.title' | translate }}.

services.httpPattern: All HTTP calls go through ApiClient in src/app/core/services/api-client.service.ts, which adds headers and maps errors.
services.errorHandling: Map failures to a user-safe message through NotificationService.
services.caching: Reference lists are cached per tenant and invalidated on create, update and delete.

styles.breakpoints: Use the mixins in src/styles/_breakpoints.scss (sm 600px, md 960px, lg 1280px); never write raw media queries.
styles.layoutOffsets: The side navigation takes 240px expanded and 64px collapsed.
styles.tokenImport: Import tokens with @use 'tokens' as t; reference t.$color-primary.

testing.mockingStyle: Provide typed fakes with useValue; prefer spies over full fakes for one-method dependencies.

migrations.notes: Mixed component libraries and missing OnPush are expected until phase 3.

docs.syncRule: Update docs/agents.md when an agent or instruction file changes.

rules: Never use a literal colour in a component stylesheet.

domains.name: Order management
domains.overview: Lists, filters and exports customer orders.
acceptanceCriteria: Search requires at least three characters.
constraints: Use OrderFacade for all data access.
domains.tests: Cover empty results, export and filter reset.
